stable.headline: A review of v0.37.1's code: eight faults fixed, among them a texture-size export, a Model mode on library shapes and lossy normal maps.
notes: Texture size in the export window no longer leaves a shrunken picture on the graphics card
Pictures as WebP keeps normal and other data maps lossless
Edit mesh closes when a library shape is picked: Bake geo first
Fault overlays share their buffers between copies of a mesh and follow their copy
8 fixes in all, found by reading the code of v0.37.1
